title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi khoản (d) Điều 5 của Đạo luật số 136, như đã được sửa đổi bởi Điều 1 của Đạo luật số 867, nhằm ủy quyền cho Thẩm phán Tòa án cấp một đang thực hiện nhiệm vụ nghỉ phép tạm thời bổ nhiệm công chứng viên trong một số trường hợp nhất định và ủy quyền cho các quan chức phụ trách công trình công cộng chủ trì tuyên thệ trong một số trường hợp nhất định
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขวรรค(ง)ของมาตรา5ของพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่หนึ่งร้อยสามสิบหกซึ่งแก้ไขแล้วโดยมาตรา1ของพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่แปดร้อยหกสิบเจ็ดเพื่อให้อำนาจผู้พิพากษาศาลชั้นต้นซึ่งปฏิบัติหน้าที่พิจารณาคดีชั่วคราวในช่วงวันหยุดทำการแต่งตั้งนายอำเภอในกรณีบางประการและให้อำนาจเจ้าหน้าที่ผู้รับผิดชอบงานสาธารณะปฏิบัติการสาบานในกรณีบางประการ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Pasal 5 ayat (d) Undang-Undang Nomor 136 sebagaimana telah diubah oleh Pasal 1 Undang-Undang Nomor 867 guna mengizinkan hakim pengadilan tingkat pertama yang menjalankan tugas liburan antara masa sidang menunjuk notaris publik dalam kasus-kasus tertentu serta mengizinkan pejabat yang bertanggung jawab atas pekerjaan umum mengambil sumpah dalam kasus-kasus tertentu
title.ms: Akta mengubah suai perenggan (d) Perkara 5 Akta Nombor Seratus Tiga Puluh Enam sebagaimana telah diubah suai oleh Perkara 1 Akta Nombor Lapan Ratus Enam Puluh Tujuh bagi memberi kuasa kepada hakim mahkamah peringkat pertama yang menjalankan tugas bercuti sementara melantik peguamcara dalam kes-kes tertentu dan memberi kuasa kepada pegawai yang bertanggungjawab ke atas kerja awam untuk mengambil sumpah dalam kes-kes tertentu

text.en:
Paragraph (d) of section five of Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-six, as amended by section
one of Act Numbered Eight hundred and sixty-seven, is hereby amended by adding at the end thereof the
following words: "The interlocutory jurisdiction shall also include the power of appointing notaries public,
as provided in section eighty-two of this Act."

Any official in charge of a public work under the authority of the Insular Government or any
provincial government, is hereby empowered to administer all oaths required by law, without compensation,
but he shall not be required to administer oaths except in matters of official business for which no fees are
chargeable by law.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 26, 1904.
